scope: Exactly five manuscript result groups; other retained declarations are proof infrastructure. Corollaries 1.4 and 1.5 and the strong forms are not advertised formal claims.

claims.label: thm:barrier-730
claims.title: Barrier from typical equilibrium states
claims.qualification: Both continuous time (site rate one) and discrete single-site attempts. For each fixed beta > 1, one A_beta > 0 is chosen before every fixed 0 < tau < 1/2 and serves both clocks. The two joint bad-start masses tend to one. Strong quantitative, almost-sure, other-dynamics, and relaxation-time forms are outside this claim.

claims.label: b:cor:subcritical
claims.title: Unit coefficient below the exponent 7/30
claims.qualification: Coefficient one for every fixed 0 < kappa < 7/30 and 0 < tau < 1/2, in both clocks. This does not assert coefficient one at kappa = 7/30.

claims.label: thm:upper
claims.title: Mixing from typical equilibrium states
claims.statement_latex:
[Mixing from typical equilibrium states]\label{thm:upper}
For every fixed $\beta>1$ and every fixed $\omega\in(0,1/4)$,
\[
 \PP_{J,\,X_0\sim\pi^J}\bigl\{d^J\bigl(X_0,e^{n^{1-\omega}}\bigr)\le 1/4\bigr\}\longrightarrow1;
 \quad\text{equivalently}\quad
 \PP_{J,\,X_0\sim\pi^J}\bigl\{T^J(X_0)\le e^{n^{1-\omega}}\bigr\}\longrightarrow1 .
\]
claims.qualification: Continuous-time statement only, each site at rate one, for every fixed beta > 1 and 0 < c < 1/4 (c is manuscript omega). The formal statement is the complementary joint probability of distance > 1/4 tending to zero. Its completed GOE diagonal cancels from Gibbs probabilities and rates. The initial Gibbs spin is sampled once and held fixed before total variation is formed. Corollaries 1.4 and 1.5 and the endpoint c = 1/4 are outside this claim.

claims.label: f:main
claims.title: Fluctuation scale (OpenAI, Theorem 1.1)
claims.qualification: All three clauses: standard-deviation exponent 1/6, variance exponent 1/3, and typical centered-fluctuation exponent 1/6, with every positive slack. Separate eventual thresholds for standard deviation and variance can be replaced by their maximum. The formal free energy subtracts n log 2, preserving centered fluctuations and variance. The positive Laplace window is proved internally. OpenAI proved the mathematical theorem; no limiting law or positive variance prefactor is claimed.

claims.label: cor:mean-bias
claims.title: Mean bias
claims.qualification: The compared export conjoins convergence of the finite-volume counting pressures to limitingPressure for every fixed beta > 1 with the unchanged lower-bound predicate: the counting-measure mean-pressure bias is at least c n^(-5/6-epsilon), with c > 0 and an eventual threshold, for every epsilon > 0. The convergence conclusion identifies the defined limUnder with the actual thermodynamic limit. The displayed extensive form is the lower bound's algebraic reformulation. The pressure convergence and variance-bias inequality are proved in the retained development. A bound with epsilon = 0 is outside this claim.

formal_convergence.conclusion: For every beta > 1, Tendsto (OAI.SKFluctuations.MeanBias.countingPressure beta) atTop (nhds (OAI.SKFluctuations.MeanBias.limitingPressure beta)).
formal_convergence.export_position: First conjunct of LowerUpperBounds.corollary_1_7; the second conjunct is the unchanged OAI.SKFluctuations.MeanBias.LowerBoundStatement.
formal_convergence.limit_definition: limitingPressure beta is limUnder atTop (countingPressure beta); convergence is asserted separately as a conclusion, not assumed from this definition.
